name: Turkestan ASSR
native: Туркестанская Советская Федеративная Республика (Turkestanskaya Sovetskaya Federativnaya Respublika)

predecessors.name: Russian Turkestan
predecessors.text: the five oblasts of the Turkestan Krai, outside the protectorates of Bukhara and Khiva

successors.name: Soviet Union
successors.text: the Turkmen SSR and the Uzbek SSR (TA: partitioned into the two), with the Tajik ASSR inside the Uzbek SSR, the Kara-Kirghiz AO and the Karakalpak AO in the RSFSR

ledger.x: 1918: the Turkestan Soviet Federative Republic is proclaimed at Tashkent.
1918: Basmachi bands hold the Fergana valley and the Tashkent countryside.
1920: the Tashkent countryside returns to the republic.
1920: the republic becomes the Turkestan Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic.
1924: the last Basmachi presence in Fergana ends.

wars.name: Transcaspian campaign (Malleson mission)
wars.outcome: The Ashkhabad government, helped by the Anglo-Indian Malleson mission, held Transcaspia until the British withdrew; by 1920 the Tashkent Soviet had regained it.

wars.name: Basmachi revolt
wars.outcome: Armed resistance that began in the summer of 1918 around Kokand (Ergash) and lasted into the 1920s; no border change while the republic lasted.

certainty.note: A civil-war state: control 'limited to only a few railway junctions' in 1918 (TA) and contested by the Basmachi; the 1920 enclaves of Bukhara and Khiva are drawn at the old protectorate lines.
